model_response.rationale: Increasing R1 from 390Ω to 820Ω reduces the nominal pushbutton-to-base feed current (I_R1) from 11.03 mA to 5.24 mA, a 52.5% reduction, meeting the ≥50% target. After the 10k pull-down shunt (0.07 mA), the actual base current is 5.17 mA. For LED-only operation (D1, Vf 1.8–2.2V, R3=330Ω), the LED current is 7.9–9.1 mA, well within the tentative forced-β=10 collector budget of 51.7 mA, so indicator operation remains plausible. External J2 load current is unknown and not assumed; no saturation/thermal guarantee is claimed.

VBE variation with temperature/current not modeled
LED Vf tolerance may shift LED current
External J2 load (if present) may exceed collector budget or cause thermal issues
